text:
Anika: Hey team — SolaceHealth kickoff week is set for Mon 2024-10-07 (9:00am PST). They asked for daily 60m office hours + a 90m hands-on lab on Wed. Need facilitator roster, prework, and a lightweight feedback form. Can we map this out? :wave:

Tom: I can lead the Wed lab. Need Dedicated pool for quantized model infer for customers' demo — @Dinesh can we provision a small Dedicated queue for 2 GPUs Wed 10:00–12:00 PST?

Dinesh: We can reserve 2 GPUs in a dev-dedicated pool for Wed. Need the model size and expected concurrency. Please drop the model artifact link and sample prompt set here or open INF ticket.

Anika: Concurrency ~3 concurrent seats, model is a ~13B quantized fork. I'll share the artifact link + sample prompts by EOD.

Eva: Heads-up — Solace renewal is Oct 28. Recommend we slot a 15m exec touchpoint on Fri to review success metrics and ROI. Renewal risk flagged as medium (they brought up cost).

Maya: I'll own facilitator scheduling. Suggested roster: Tom (lab lead), Maya (ops), Anika (customer liaison), Liam (follow-ups). Anyone need to swap? :calendar:

Liam: I can take the Fri exec slot and prep adoption metrics + a short slide on usage trends.

CalendarBot: Provisional invites created:
- Solace Kickoff — Mon 09:00–10:00 PST (team)
- Office Hours — Tue/Thu 10:00–11:00 PST
- Hands-on Lab — Wed 10:00–11:30 PST
- Exec Review — Fri 11:00–11:15 PST
Invite link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/ev/abc123

RecordingBot: All sessions will be recorded and uploaded to #customer-recordings and Solace shared drive. We'll also auto-generate a short highlights clip.

Anika: Prework we want to send: 1) environment checklist (1 page), 2) sample dataset + allowed prompt set, 3) access instructions for the Dedicated queue. Also want a 5-question feedback form after the lab. Can someone draft the form?

Tom: I'll draft the feedback form and the concise lab agenda. Quick agenda snippet below:
```
10:00 Intro & goals (10m)
10:10 Live setup + prefix/KV caching demo (25m)
10:35 Guided prompts + evaluation set (30m)
11:05 Q&A + next steps (25m)
```
I'll post the full draft by EOD.

Maya: Created a short Doodle for facilitator availability and an RSVP for attendees: https://doodle.com/poll/xyz789 — pls fill by EOD tomorrow so we can finalize invites. :bell:

Dinesh: Opened infra ticket INF-4876 for the Dedicated reservation. ETA for allocation: Tue 17:00 PST. Once reserved, I'll post the endpoint + creds to the ticket (privately). Tag me if smoke tests fail.

Eva: Can we include a 1-slide cost breakdown for the Friday exec review? Solace specifically asked about per-token/unit economics and options to reduce spend.

Tom: Yes — I'll run a sample trace with the quantized profile and include a before/after Optimize suggestion (batching, KV caching).

Liam: Also recommend attaching a 1-page rollback/fallback plan: model variant mapping, automatic routing to fallback model, and expected latency/loss tradeoffs. Helps with exec comfort.

Anika: Perfect. I'll assemble the runbook (setup steps, contact list, rollback plan, feedback form) and send to Solace by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone :pray:

Maya: One last ask — can we run a quick dry-run Tue 09:00 PST with facilitators only? Quick checklist: recording, env, sample prompt run.

Tom: Dry-run works for me.

Dinesh: I'll be on the dry-run to confirm Dedicated endpoint and KV cache behavior.

Anika: Great — locking dry-run Tue 09:00 PST. I'll DM the customer-facing invite after we confirm facilitator RSVP.

Eva: I'll add a short survey to capture renewal sentiment during the exec review (3 quick multiple choice items).

Anika: Awesome. Closing the loop — final checklist: infra ticket (INF-4876), calendar invites (CalendarBot), facilitator Doodle (Maya), lab agenda & feedback (Tom), exec slide (Liam/Eva).

RecordingBot: Reminder set to start recordings automatically for the Wed lab and Fri exec review.

Maya: Thanks team — I'll update the shared tracker with these owners and deadlines. :white_check_mark:
